arXiv:2607.08754v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 7 月 9 日arXiv:2607.08754v1 [cs.LG] 09 Jul 2026

SLORR：简单高效的训练中低阶正则化SLORR: Simple and Efficient In-Training Low-Rank Regularization

David González-Martínez1,2,3,4  Shiwei Liu1,3,4
1Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems  2University of Tübingen
3ELLIS Institute Tübingen  4Tübingen AI Center
david.martinez@tuebingen.mpg.de  sliu@tue.ellis.eu
摘要Abstract

低秩分解广泛用于压缩神经网络，但现代模型通常不能自然地适应激进的分解而不造成显着的准确性损失。现有的训练时低秩正则化器可以提高可压缩性，但它们通常需要大型权重矩阵的 SVD、修改模型架构（引入额外的可训练参数）或依赖有状态的缓存量。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 SLORR，这是一种简单、无状态且保留架构的框架，用于训练中的低秩正则化，并使用基于 Hoyer 稀疏度度量和核范数的两个主要变体进行实例化。 SLORR 使用 GPU 友好的近似值直接正则化原始权重矩阵，用于正则化器的前向和后向传递，为此我们提供近似保证。我们首先在 ResNet-50、ViT-B/16 和 ViT-L/16 的短期持续训练以及 ResNet-18 的预训练中评估 ImageNet-1K 上的 SLORR，其中 SLORR 引入可压缩性，同时引入不到 8% 的训练开销。我们进一步在 135M 和 560M 规模的 LLM 预训练中评估 SLORR-Hoyer：SLORR 训练的压缩模型比非正则化模型保持了更好的性能，同时增加了不到 1% 的平均训练开销。Low-rank factorization is widely used to compress neural networks, but modern models are often not naturally amenable to aggressive factorization without significant accuracy loss. Existing training-time low-rank regularizers can improve compressibility, but they often require SVDs of large weight matrices, modify the model architecture (introducing additional trainable parameters), or rely on stateful cached quantities. To address these limitations, we introduce SLORR, a simple, stateless, and architecture-preserving framework for in-training low-rank regularization, instantiated with two main variants based on the Hoyer sparsity metric and the nuclear norm. SLORR directly regularizes the original weight matrices using GPU-friendly approximations for the forward and backward passes of the regularizers, for which we provide approximation guarantees. We first evaluate SLORR on ImageNet-1K across short-horizon continued training of ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16, and pretraining of ResNet-18, where SLORR induces compressibility while introducing less than 8% training overhead. We further evaluate SLORR-Hoyer in LLM pretraining at 135M and 560M scales: SLORR-trained compressed models preserve performance substantially better than unregularized models while adding less than 1% average training overhead.

1 简介Introduction

低秩分解是一种广泛使用的方法，用于降低神经网络的计算和内存成本：密集的权重矩阵被较小因子的乘积取代，当保留的秩足够小时，可以产生更便宜的推理Low-rank factorization is a widely used approach for reducing the computational and memory costs of neural networks: a dense weight matrix is replaced by a product of smaller factors, yielding cheaper inference when the retained rank is sufficiently small[4, 10, 24, 6]。然而，压缩质量取决于权重矩阵的谱特性：丢弃有意义的谱方向会降低模型性能。因此，虽然适度的训练后压缩通常是可能的，但现代模型通常无法自然地适应激进的分解而不导致显着的准确性损失。. However, compression quality depends on the spectral properties of weight matrices: discarding meaningful spectral directions can degrade model performance. Thus, while moderate post-training compression is generally possible, modern models are often not naturally amenable to aggressive factorization without significant accuracy loss.

这激发了训练时方法，鼓励压缩前的低秩结构。一个自然的公式是鼓励权重矩阵奇异值的稀疏性，将谱集中到较少的主导方向上。尽管直接谱正则化可能是有效的This motivates training-time methods that encourage low-rank structure before compression. A natural formulation is to encourage sparsity in the singular values of weight matrices, concentrating spectra into fewer dominant directions. Although direct spectral regularization can be effective[2, 55]，每次训练迭代都需要大量的奇异值分解（SVD），这对于现代训练管道来说是非常昂贵的。, large singular value decompositions (SVDs) are needed at every training iteration, which is prohibitively expensive for modern training pipelines.

已经提出了几种避免 SVD 的方法Several ways of avoiding SVDs have been proposed[56, 1, 15];然而，这些通常会带来阻碍实用性的新限制。例如，一些作品用分解参数化替换层，改变架构; however, these generally introduce new limitations that hinder practicality. For example, some works replace layers with factorized parameterizations, changing the architecture[1, 56]，但这通常会增加可训练参数的数量并改变优化动态。另一类方法维护仅定期更新的缓存光谱量, but this generally increases the number of trainable parameters and alters optimization dynamics. A further class of methods maintains cached spectral quantities that are only periodically updated[15]，减少但没有消除 SVD 成本，并引入状态性和额外的超参数。, reducing but not eliminating SVD cost, and introducing statefulness and additional hyperparameters.

我们提出的方法 SLORR 解决了这些限制。特别是，SLORR直接对原始权重矩阵进行操作，无需改变架构，无SVD且高效，并且不维护任何缓存量，提供了通用的框架。关键思想很简单：我们使用 GPU 高效的极因子近似来近似正则化器前向和后向传递所需的光谱量。我们探索两个主要变体：SLORR-Hoyer 和 SLORR-Nuc，它们分别对应于平方 Hoyer 稀疏度度量Our proposed method, SLORR, addresses these limitations. In particular, SLORR operates directly on the original weight matrices without altering the architecture, is SVD-free and efficient, and does not maintain any cached quantities, providing a versatile framework. The key idea is simple: we approximate the spectral quantities needed for the regularizer forward and backward passes using GPU-efficient polar factor approximations. We explore two main variants: SLORR-Hoyer and SLORR-Nuc, which respectively correspond to the squared Hoyer sparsity metric[23]和核规范，这是两种常见的低级惩罚。对于这两种变体，所得的近似值都保证了正则化值及其梯度（and the nuclear norm, two common low-rank penalties. For both variants, the resulting approximations admit guarantees for the regularizer values and their gradients (Proposition˜3.1）。直接相关工作的摘要出现在). A summary of directly relevant related works appears inTable˜1，并进行了更广泛的讨论, with a more extensive discussion inSection˜2.

根据经验，我们评估了跨视觉和语言建模设置的 SLORR。在 ImageNet-1K 上Empirically, we evaluate SLORR across vision and language-modeling settings. On ImageNet-1K[9]，我们研究ResNet-50的短视野持续训练, we study short-horizon continued training of ResNet-50[20]、ViT-B/16 和 ViT-L/16, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16[12]，以及 ResNet-18 预训练, as well as ResNet-18 pretraining[20]。在这些设置中，SLORR 比非正则训练​​提高了训练后的压缩性，同时增加了不到 8% 的训练开销。我们进一步在 135M 和 560M 规模的 LLM 预训练上评估 SLORR-Hoyer，其中 SLORR 训练的模型在压缩后比非正则化模型保留了更好的性能，平均训练开销不到 1%。. Across these settings, SLORR improves post-training compressibility over unregularized training while adding less than 8% training overhead. We further evaluate SLORR-Hoyer on LLM pretraining at the 135M and 560M scales, where SLORR-trained models preserve performance substantially better after compression than unregularized models, with less than 1% average training overhead.

总的来说，我们的贡献如下。首先，我们引入了一个无 SVD 框架，使用 GPU 友好的近似来进行低秩诱导正则化。其次，我们展示了如何使用该框架来正则化原始权重矩阵的频谱，而无需更改架构、缓存频谱量或预先指定的目标等级。第三，我们通过视觉和语言建模实验证明，SLORR 以较小的训练开销提高了训练后的低秩压缩性。Overall, our contributions are as follows. First, we introduce an SVD-free framework for low-rank-inducing regularization using GPU-friendly approximations. Second, we show how this framework can be used to regularize the spectra of the original weight matrices without architectural changes, cached spectral quantities, or a pre-specified target rank. Third, we demonstrate across vision and language-modeling experiments that SLORR improves post-training low-rank compressibility with small training overhead.

2.1 引入低阶参数Inducing Low-Rank Parameters

由于通过 SVD 截断来压缩层本质上相当于截断其奇异值，因此所产生的精度下降与其谱属性直接相关：理想的属性是层权重（大约）是低秩的。因此，获得更多可压缩层的直观方法是对模型进行正则化，以在训练期间逐渐降低其权重矩阵的（近似）等级。人们可以粗略地将秩最小化目标视为参数奇异值的稀疏目标，即Since compressing layers by SVD truncation essentially amounts to truncating their singular values, the accuracy degradation incurred is directly related to their spectral properties: a desirable property is that the layer weight is (approximately) low-rank. Hence, an intuitive approach to obtaining more compressible layers is to regularize the model to gradually decrease the (approximate) rank of its weight matrices during training. One can roughly think of the rank minimization objective as a sparsity objective on the singular values of the parameters, i.e.,

ℒ=ℒtask+λ​∑irank⁡(𝑾i)=ℒtask+λ​∑i‖𝝈​(𝑾i)‖0,\mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{task}}+\lambda\sum_{i}\operatorname{rank}({\bm{W}}^{i})=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{task}}+\lambda\sum_{i}\|\bm{\sigma}({\bm{W}}^{i})\|_{0},

哪里where𝝈\bm{\sigma}表示奇异值denotes the singular values of𝑾i{\bm{W}}^{i}。这个目标被认为是棘手的. This objective is considered to be intractable[13]。先前的工作已经通过使用代理目标来解决这个问题，例如最小化核规范. Prior work has addressed this by using proxy objectives, such as minimizing the nuclear norm[2, 55];然而，这通常需要在每个训练步骤中计算每个权重的 SVD，这对于较大的模型来说在计算上是难以实现的。已经提出了几种解决方案。; however, this generally requires computing the SVDs of each weight at each training step, which is computationally prohibitive for larger models. Several solutions have been proposed.

有些方法依赖于修改架构。例如，Some approaches rely on modifying the architecture. For example,Yang et al. The authors then incentivize𝝈\bm{\sigma}通过 Hoyer 稀疏度度量变得稀疏to be sparse through the Hoyer sparsity metric[23]（他们还探索(they also explore theℓ1\ell_{1}范数，类似于核范数正则化）。需要一个额外的正则化器来保持norm, akin to nuclear-norm regularization). An additional regularizer is required to keep𝑼{\bm{U}}和and𝑽{\bm{V}}正交并保持通用 SVD 语义，使其不太实用。最近的一种方法，名为 LoRITaorthogonal and maintain general SVD semantics, making it less practical. These approaches generally increase the number of trainable parameters and can alter optimization dynamics.

另一项工作重用计算的因子，而不是在每次迭代时重新计算它们。比如最近的Q3RAnother line of work reuses computed factors instead of recomputing them at every iteration. For example, the recent Q3R[15]使用可以用周期性 SVD 近似的替代目标uses a surrogate objective that can be approximated with periodic SVDs111他们的主要实验以 5 次迭代的刷新周期运行，这是昂贵的。在我们主要的 Q3R 实验中，我们也使用 5；然而，我们发现使用较长的周期（成本较低）也可以很好地发挥作用（Their main experiments are run with a refresh period of 5 iterations, which is expensive. In our main Q3R experiments, we also use 5; however, we found that using a larger period (which is less expensive) can also work well (Appendix F）。主要关注的是可扩展性。由于使用较大的型号，Q3R要保持低成本就需要延长刷新周期。预计刷新周期足够长时，其有效性将会降低。). The main concern is scalability. As one uses larger models, maintaining a low cost with Q3R requires enlarging the refresh period. It is expected that, with a sufficiently large refresh period, its effectiveness will be reduced.。然而，它是有状态的（因为它需要存储临时因素直到重新计算）。它还需要提前指定目标等级，这使得超参数调整具有挑战性。. However, it is stateful (as it needs to store the temporary factors until they are recomputed). It also requires specifying a target rank in advance, making hyperparameter tuning challenging.

[33]提出用于广义低秩正则化的随机可微代理，将它们应用于矩阵补全、视频前景/背景分离和去噪等任务。虽然该方法在理论上是无 SVD 的，但它仍然不切实际，需要通过长链矩阵乘法进行反向传播。而且，其实际执行propose randomized differentiable surrogates for generalized low-rank regularization, applying them to tasks including matrix completion, video foreground/background separation, and denoising. InTable˜1，我们比较相关的直接低秩正则化方法。我们提出的方法更简单：它在原始模型上运行，无 SVD 并且在实践中高效，并且是无状态的。, we compare relevant direct low-rank regularization methods. Our proposed approach is simpler: it operates on the original model, is SVD-free and efficient in practice, and is stateless.

最后，一个相关领域，但本质上有根本不同，是低秩训练，其中秩通常在训练之前预先定义，并且直接训练低秩架构。随着时间的推移，已经研究了不同的变体，例如全秩预热或与稀疏训练的组合，以及初始化等方面Lastly, a related area, but fundamentally different in nature, is that of low-rank training, where the rank is generally pre-defined before training, and a low-rank architecture is directly trained. Different variants, such as full-rank warmup or combinations with sparse training, and aspects like initialization, have been investigated over time[35, 28, 27, 53, 19, 32].

奇异值范围为The singular value range inProposition˜3.1是归一化矩阵的理论假设，继承自 Polar Express 分析is a theoretical assumption on the normalized matrix, inherited from the Polar Express analysis inAmsel et al. [3]。在实践中，Polar Express 对待. In practice, Polar Express treatsℓ\ell作为近似下界参数；作者报告说，不准确的猜测通常并不严重。因此，显示的最坏情况界限应解释为适用于位于以下位置的归一化非零奇异值：as an approximate lower bound parameter; the authors report that inaccurate guesses are typically not severe. Therefore, the displayed worst case bound should be interpreted as applying to normalized nonzero singular values lying in[ℓ,1][\ell,1]，而我们的选择, while our choiceℓ=10−3\ell=10^{-3}遵循他们的推荐值。我们还强调，这是理想化环境中最坏的情况。在实践中，即使界限不紧，少量迭代也能很好地工作，并且浮点误差和实现细节可能会引入额外的近似误差。我们遵循实际的实施选择follows their recommended value. We also emphasize that this is a worst case bound in an idealized setting. In practice, a smaller number of iterations works well even when the bound is not tight, and floating point error and implementation details may introduce additional approximation error. We follow the practical implementation choices ofAmsel et al. [3]，包括其推荐的参数设置和数值稳定性。进一步的讨论见, including their recommended parameter settings and numerical stabilizations. Further discussion is provided inSection˜D.1和andAppendix˜C.

4 实验Experiments

我们的目标是评估 SLORR 在训练期间诱导压缩性的有效性。我们的实验涵盖两个主要领域：ImageNet-1K 上的图像分类Our goal is to evaluate the effectiveness of SLORR in inducing compressibility during training. Our experiments cover two main domains: image classification on ImageNet-1K[9]，包括从检查点开始的持续培训和预培训，以及 LLM 预培训。我们的总体流程包括首先训练正则化和非正则化模型，然后压缩它们并评估它们的保留性能。除非另有说明，正则化和压缩适用于除第一层和最后一层之外的所有线性层和卷积层；对于变压器，这对应于变压器块内的层。在我们的实验中，SLORR-Hoyer-D 表示解耦变体，如下, including both continued training from a checkpoint and pretraining, and LLM pretraining. Our general pipeline consists of first training regularized and unregularized models, and then compressing them and assessing their retained performance. Unless stated otherwise, regularization and compression are applied to all linear and convolutional layers, except for the first and last layers; for transformers, this corresponds to the layers inside the transformer blocks. In our experiments, SLORR-Hoyer-D denotes the decoupled variant, followingSection˜D.2.

我们的代码位于Our code is available athttps://github.com/davidgonmar/SLORR.

4.1 图像分类实验Image Classification Experiments

我们首先评估 ImageNet-1K 分类上的 SLORR。我们涵盖两种设置：跨四种架构的预训练和持续训练。我们与最近的基线进行比较，这些基线主要集中在图像分类领域。我们总共在不同设置中执行了 150 多次运行。We first evaluate SLORR on ImageNet-1K classification. We cover two settings: pretraining and continued training, across four architectures. We compare against recent baselines, which have largely focused on the image classification domain. In total, we perform more than 150 runs across settings.

These baselines are used because: (1) they are the most recent relevant methods, to the best of our knowledge, and (2) they allow us to compare different objectives, whereas factorization-based approaches[56]通常与我们的目标相似，但在改变架构后对其进行优化。generally have similar objectives to ours but optimize them after altering the architecture.

压缩。Compression.

训练后，我们使用两种不同的方法进行压缩。第一个是均匀压缩，其中每一层都保留（大约）均匀的参数比例和跨层的 FLOP。我们分别执行基于能量的截断，其中保留阈值After training, we perform compression using two different approaches. The first is uniform compression, in which every layer retains (approximately) a uniform ratio of parameters and FLOPs across layers. 扩展：不同 ViT 规模的开销。Scaling up: overhead across different ViT scales.

我们通过测量 B200 GPU 上从 ViT-T 到 ViT-H 规模的相对时间和内存成本来评估正则化开销如何在现代硬件上扩展（We evaluate how regularization overhead scales on modern hardware by measuring the relative time and memory costs on B200 GPUs from ViT-T through ViT-H scale (Figure˜2）。这揭示了一个关键的扩展权衡：虽然具有大周期的 Q3R 可能是高效的，但随着模型尺寸的增加，需要更大的刷新周期来保持效率。虽然在我们的设置中可以使用较长的刷新周期，但我们预计刷新频率足够低最终会降低正则化质量。尽管我们的规模尚未达到“饱和点”，但这是可扩展性方面需要考虑的一个重要方面。). This reveals a key scaling tradeoff: while Q3R with large periods can be efficient, larger refresh periods are needed to maintain efficiency as model size increases. While large refresh periods work in our settings, we expect sufficiently infrequent refreshes to eventually reduce regularization quality. Although we do not reach that “saturation point” in our scales, this is an important aspect to take into account in terms of scalability.101010虽然 Q3R 依赖于精确的 SVD，但尝试近似 SVD 可能是未来工作的一个有趣途径，这可能会提高可扩展性。While Q3R relies on exact SVDs, it might be an interesting avenue for future work to try approximate SVDs, which might improve scalability.

压缩结果。Compression results.

135M 和 560M 型号的结果见Results for the 135M and 560M models are presented inFigure˜3。报告的参数比是在变压器块上计算的。特别是，按照该领域的常见做法，嵌入和最终层不会被压缩。我们发现 SLORR-Hoyer 在普通 SVD 和 SVD-LLM 压缩下都提高了可压缩性。普通 SVD 对于法学硕士来说特别脆弱，因为即使只删除一小部分块参数，困惑度也会急剧下降。尽管 SLORR 训练的模型具有稍高的未压缩困惑度，但在轻度压缩（例如，10% 参数去除，对应于 0.9 的保留参数比率）后，它们的性能优于未正则化模型。在参数计数比率较低时，差距显着扩大。. The reported parameter ratios are computed over the transformer blocks. In particular, embeddings and the final layer are not compressed, following common practice in this area. We find that SLORR-Hoyer improves compressibility under both plain SVD and SVD-LLM compression. Plain SVD is particularly brittle for LLMs, as perplexity degrades sharply even when only a small fraction of block parameters is removed. Although SLORR-trained models have slightly higher uncompressed perplexity, they outperform unregularized models after mild compression, e.g., 10% parameter removal, corresponding to a retained parameter ratio of 0.9. The gap widens significantly at lower parameter count ratios.

对于 560M 模型，我们观察到下游任务性能的类似趋势。虽然非正则化模型很快就会遭受显着退化，但正则化模型即使在较高的压缩比下，总体上仍能保持较高的下游性能，但代价是某些任务的未压缩性能受到轻微影响。For the 560M model, we observe similar trends in downstream task performance. While the unregularized model quickly suffers from significant degradation, regularized models maintain substantially higher downstream performance in general, even at higher compression ratios, at the cost of a slight hit in uncompressed performance on some tasks.

训练时间较长。Longer training.

如上所述，我们的主要模型经过训练以达到计算最优的代币预算As noted above, our main models are trained to the compute-optimal token budget[22]。我们还对 1.35 亿个模型进行更长时间的训练，特别是计算最佳代币预算的 4 倍和 8 倍，以探索收益是否会转移到更长时间的训练中。我们发现，随着模型训练时间的延长，它们在我们的环境中变得不太可压缩，无论是在非正则化还是正则化训练下。然而，正则化模型仍然更具可压缩性。这些结果显示在. We also train 135M models for longer, specifically for 4 and 8 times the compute-optimal token budget, to explore whether the gains transfer to longer training. We find that, as models are trained for longer, they become less compressible in our setting, both under unregularized and regularized training. However, regularized models remain more compressible. These results are shown inAppendix˜J，其中表格值, with tabular values inAppendix˜K.

可视化 SLORR 对权重谱的影响。Visualizing the effect of SLORR on weight spectra.

SLORR 提升低等级的目的是使模型适合因式分解。当然，这直接反映在权重谱的视觉特性中，其中更强的正则化会导致更快的奇异值衰减。我们在附录中包含所有 Llama 135M 层的图（SLORR promotes low rank with the objective of making models amenable to factorization. Naturally, this is directly reflected in the visual properties of weight spectra, where stronger regularization induces faster singular value decay. We include plots for all Llama 135M layers in the appendix (Figure˜5），其中光谱集中效应很明显。也许令人惊讶的是，嵌入矩阵中存在可见的光谱差异，但最终的线性层中没有。由于嵌入层未进行正则化，这表明修改正则化层的光谱可能会影响模型的其他部分。), where the spectral concentration effect is apparent. Perhaps surprisingly, there are visible spectral differences in the embedding matrix, but not in the final linear layer. Since the embedding layer was not regularized, this indicates that modifying the spectra of regularized layers can affect other parts of the model.

5 讨论Discussion

局限性。Limitations.

权重低秩正则化可能并非在每种情况下都有效。在探索性实验中，我们发现在保留一般能力的同时对低秩正则化的 LLM 进行微调具有挑战性，这表明数据和训练设置很重要，正如人们所期望的那样。此外，最终精度和可压缩性之间通常需要权衡，过度正则化可能会导致训练不稳定，特别是对于 Hoyer 变体。此外，尽管我们的实验比之前的工作要广泛得多（在 ImageNet-1K 上运行超过 150 次），但正则化器的性能可能会因训练设置和超参数而异。同样，我们也没有探索每种环境下的每种 SLORR 变体。因此，尽管我们提供了广泛的尽力比较，但我们的结果不应被解释为所有方法的明确排名。最后，我们的理论虽然内容丰富，但所依赖的具体假设可能并不适用于所有实际情况。Weight low-rank regularization may not be effective in every setting. In exploratory experiments, we found that fine-tuning LLMs with low-rank regularization while preserving general capabilities was challenging, suggesting that the data and training setup are important, as one might expect. Additionally, there is generally a tradeoff between final accuracy and compressibility, and excessive regularization can cause training instabilities, particularly for the Hoyer variant. Moreover, although our experiments are significantly more extensive than those of prior work (more than 150 runs on ImageNet-1K), the performance of regularizers can vary depending on the training setting and hyperparameters. Similarly, we did not explore every SLORR variant in every setting. Therefore, although we provide a broad best-effort comparison, our results should not be interpreted as a definitive ranking of all methods. Finally, our theory, while informative, relies on specific assumptions that may not hold in every practical case.

未来的工作。Future work.

一个有希望的方向是将正则化与补充技术相结合，例如周期性截断，类似于One promising direction is to combine regularization with complementary techniques, such as periodic truncation, similar toXu et al. [55]，或多轮再训练和压缩。正则化强度表，如, or multiple rounds of retraining and compression. Regularization strength schedules, as inDolatabadi et al. [11]，也可能会产生更好的结果。此外，优化中正交化的需求引发了对更有效的极函数近似的研究，例如：, would likely also yield better results. Moreover, the need for orthogonalization in optimization has sparked research into more effective polar-function approximations, e.g.,[60]，可应用于 SLORR。最后，我们相信我们的工作可以激发超出本文范围的更广泛的研究。尽管这项工作的主要应用是直接规范权重，但 SLORR 的多功能性可能会在无法依赖架构修改或缓存数量有效性的环境中开辟新的途径。例如，通过核范数激活的低阶正则化已被证明可以增强泛化能力, which could be applied to SLORR. Finally, we believe our work could motivate broader research beyond the scope of this paper. Although the main application of this work is to directly regularize weights, the versatility of SLORR may open new avenues in settings where one cannot rely on architectural modifications or the validity of cached quantities. For example, low-rank regularization of activations via the nuclear norm has been shown to enhance generalization[48];虽然该工作使用 SVD，但可以使用我们的方法计算出有效的版本。同样，虽然很重要，但扩展低秩正则化以鼓励激活位于子空间中，从而更好地使用激活感知分解方法将很有趣。更广泛地说，一种可访问的正则化排名方法可能会激发除本文研究之外的更广泛的排名正则化应用的工作，包括鼓励更高排名可能有益的环境。; while that work uses SVDs, an efficient version could potentially be computed using our approach. Similarly, although nontrivial, it would be interesting to extend low-rank regularization to encourage activations to lie in a subspace, enabling better use of activation-aware factorization methods. More broadly, an accessible way to regularize rank may motivate work on broader applications of rank regularization beyond those studied here, including settings where encouraging a higher rank may be beneficial.

结论。Conclusion.

我们引入了 SLORR，一个直接将权重矩阵正则化为低阶的框架。这个想法很简单，但用途广泛：它不需要 SVD，保持高效，直接在正则化的矩阵上运行，并且是无状态的。我们在 ImageNet-1K 图像分类和 LLM 预训练上的实验表明，该正则化器可以有效地生成更多可压缩模型，同时保持训练效率。更广泛地说，尽管我们专注于重量压缩，但我们对这种多功能性可能在其他用例中开辟的途径感到兴奋。We have introduced SLORR, a framework for directly regularizing weight matrices to be low rank. The idea is simple yet highly versatile: it does not require SVDs, remains efficient, operates directly on the matrix being regularized, and is stateless. Our experiments on ImageNet-1K image classification and LLM pretraining show that this regularizer is effective at producing more compressible models while maintaining training efficiency. More broadly, although we focused on weight compression, we are excited about the avenues that this versatility may open in other use cases.

然后，我们在通过正则化器进行反向传播时使用这些表达式。我们注意到，直观上，这些对应于通过 PyTorch 中的函数组合单独反向传播，并将核范数的梯度设置为广义极因子。我们使用这一特定选择是因为它通常是通过多项式近似（例如 Polar Express）计算出来的。We then use these expressions when backpropagating through the regularizers. We remark that, intuitively, these correspond to backpropagating individually through the composition of functions in PyTorch, and setting the gradient of the nuclear norm to the generalized polar factor. We use this specific choice because it is the one that is generally (approximately) computed by polynomial approximations such as Polar Express.

请注意零奇异值。Remark about zero singular values.

我们使用的 Polar Express 保证仅涉及非零奇异子空间，对应于本文中使用的广义极因子（即使用薄 SVD）。因此，精确的零奇异值被从结果中排除。在精确算术中，Polar Express 更新不会在这个零奇异子空间中创建分量，因为迭代中使用的标量多项式映射满足The Polar Express guarantee we use only concerns the nonzero singular subspace, corresponding to the generalized polar factor (i.e., using the thin SVD) used throughout this paper. Exact zero singular values are therefore excluded from the result. In exact arithmetic, the Polar Express updates do not create components in this zero singular subspace, since the scalar polynomial maps used in their iteration satisfyp​(0)=0p(0)=0。因此，零奇异值在理想化迭代下保持为零，因此我们的近似保证仅涉及非零奇异值。. Thus, zero singular values remain zero under the idealized iteration, and hence our approximation guarantee concerns only the nonzero singular values.

𝑾~=𝑾‖𝑾‖F+ε.\widetilde{{\bm{W}}}=\frac{{\bm{W}}}{\|{\bm{W}}\|_{F}+\varepsilon}.

However, it does not by itself guarantee that every nonzero singular value is at leastℓ\ell。参数. 关于实际考虑的评论。Remark about practical considerations.

上述保证是理想化 Polar Express 迭代的最坏情况界限，不应被解读为对所实现的近似误差的严格估计。在我们的实验中，我们使用少量的 Polar Express 迭代以及实际的适应The guarantee above is a worst-case bound for the idealized Polar Express iteration and should not be read as a tight estimate of the implemented approximation error. In our experiments, we use a small number of Polar Express iterations together with the practical adaptations ofAmsel et al. [3]。这些选择稍微偏离理想化定理，并且浮点运算可能会引入额外的误差。根据经验，这种设置在我们的实验中效果很好；看到. These choices slightly deviate from the idealized theorem, and floating point arithmetic can introduce additional error. Empirically, this setting works well in our experiments; seeSection˜D.1了解消融和实施细节。for an ablation and implementation details.

D.2 解耦变体的实现细节Implementation Details for the Decoupled Variant

Algorithm˜1详细介绍了如何以解耦形式应用 SLORR 正则化器的梯度。这遵循 AdamW 的基本原理details how the gradient of the SLORR regularizer can be applied in a decoupled form. This follows the rationale of AdamW[38]，其中基于更新前的权重应用权重衰减。 SLORR-Hoyer-D 遵循这种方法，但请注意，这种方法也可以应用于 SLORR-Nuc。请注意，在实践中，也可以计算正则化器值（不仅仅是梯度）（与梯度同时），并且例如记录。, where weight decay is applied based on the pre-update weights. SLORR-Hoyer-D follows this approach, but note that this approach can also be applied to SLORR-Nuc. Note that, in practice, the regularizer value (not only the gradient) can also be computed (at the same time as the gradient) and, for example, logged.

D.3 内存高效变体的实现细节Implementation Details for the Memory-Efficient Variant

Algorithm˜2详细介绍了一种适用于 PyTorch 环境的内存效率更高的方法。当作为损失函数实现时（即，不是以解耦的形式，详见details a more memory-efficient approach for PyTorch environments. When implemented as a loss function (i.e., not in decoupled form, as detailed inSection˜D.2），使用 autograd 函数很容易实现。然而，如果计算每个层的损失，将它们相加，然后反向传播，PyTorch 会保留所有层的中间值。这会消耗与正则化层的总大小成比例的额外内存。同样，这可以应用于 SLORR-Nuc 和 SLORR-Hoyer。类似于), using an autograd function is easy to implement. However, if one computes each layer-wise loss, sums them, and then backpropagates, PyTorch keeps intermediate values for all layers. This can consume additional memory proportional to the total size of the regularized layers. Again, this can be applied to both SLORR-Nuc and SLORR-Hoyer. Similar toSection˜D.2，如果需要，也可以同时计算正则化值。, the regularizer value can also be computed at the same time, if needed.

E.1 解释卷积层Interpreting Convolutional Layers

对于分解和正则化，我们通过重塑将每个卷积核解释为矩阵For factorization and regularization, we interpret each convolutional kernel as a matrix by reshaping

𝑾∈ℝCo×Ci×Hk×Wk{\bm{\mathsfit{W}}}\in\mathbb{R}^{C_{o}\times C_{i}\times H_{k}\times W_{k}}

as reshape⁡(𝑾;(Co,−1))\operatorname{reshape}({\bm{\mathsfit{W}}};(C_{o},-1))。在这种解释下的低秩分解对应于用两个连续卷积替换原始卷积。这是先前低阶分解工作（包括 LoRITa）中使用的标准通道分解。. A low-rank factorization under this interpretation corresponds to replacing the original convolution with two sequential convolutions. This is the standard channel-wise decomposition used in prior low-rank factorization work, including LoRITa.

我们主要按照以下描述实现 LoRITaWe implement LoRITa largely as described inAlkhouri et al. [1]，进行一些调整。我们修复, with a few adaptations. E.2.2 Q3R

按照作者推荐的设置，我们使用他们的 AdamQ3R 优化器。 AdamQ3R 将 Adam 式优化与 Q3R 正则化器相结合，以 AdamW 驱动的解耦形式应用正则化效果Following the authors’ recommended setup, we use their AdamQ3R optimizer. AdamQ3R combines Adam-style optimization with the Q3R regularizer, applying the regularization effect in a decoupled form motivated by AdamW[38]。我们从作者的官方代码库复制了优化器和正则化器的实现. We copied the optimizer and regularizer implementation from the authors’ official codebase131313https://github.com/ThatE10/Q3R并保持线性层路径不变，只是我们添加了对解耦权重衰减的支持以匹配我们的 AdamW 基线。and left the linear-layer path unchanged, except that we added support for decoupled weight decay to match our AdamW baselines.

除非另有说明，我们对所有主要实验使用 5 的刷新间隔，遵循 Q3R 作者在其主要实验中使用的设置。我们还发现，在某些设置中，更大、更便宜的刷新间隔可以很好地发挥作用。看到We use a refresh interval of 5 for all main experiments, unless noted otherwise, following the setting used by the Q3R authors in their main experiments. We also found that larger, cheaper refresh intervals can work well in some settings; seeAppendix˜F.

原始实现不支持卷积层。我们通过将卷积层解释为矩阵将其扩展到卷积，如中所述The original implementation does not support convolutional layers. We extend it to convolutions by interpreting convolutional layers as matrices, as described inSection˜E.1。此扩展仅插入必要的重塑操作，而代码的其他部分保持不变。. This extension only inserts the necessary reshape operations and leaves other parts of the code untouched.

当我们提到 Q3R 的“目标排名”时，我们指的是传递给 AdamQ3R 优化器的值。该值可以是 0 和 1 之间的比率，而不是绝对排名。When we refer to Q3R’s “target rank”, we mean the value passed to the AdamQ3R optimizer. This value can be a ratio between 0 and 1 rather than an absolute rank.

E.3 训练细节和超参数Training Details and Hyperparameters

我们首先描述一般训练设置，然后列出每个模型的特定超参数。We first describe the general training setup and then list specific hyperparameters for each model.

正则化和因式分解应用于层的本机参数化。特别是，Regularization and factorization are applied to layers in their native parameterization. In particular, the蒂姆timmViT 实现使用融合的 QKV 层，我们对这些融合矩阵进行正则化和因式分解，而不拆分它们。这是 LoRITa 的 ViT 实施之后的结果。 Q3R 的实验分割了 QKV 层，但我们注意到这是一个实验选择，而不是该方法固有的机制（我们注意到，在任何情况下，这种选择必须在所有方法中保持一致）。因此，为了简单起见，我们使用默认的融合 QKV 实现。我们没有探索分割 QKV 层。ViT implementations use fused QKV layers, and we regularize and factorize these fused matrices without splitting them. This follows LoRITa’s ViT implementation. Q3R’s experiments split QKV layers, but we note this is an experimental choice rather than a mechanism inherent to the method (we remark that, in any case, this choice must be consistent across all methods). Hence, for simplicity, we use the default fused QKV implementation. We did not explore split QKV layers.

我们尽可能保持跨方法的非正则化超参数固定。对于 LoRITa，因子权重衰减是该方法的一部分，并且随着其正则化强度的变化而变化。对于 Q3R，我们的 AdamQ3R 实现支持 AdamW 基线和 SLORR 运行所使用的相同解耦权重衰减。在各种方法中，普通权重衰减仅适用于权重矩阵；归一化参数和偏差不会衰减。We keep non-regularizer hyperparameters fixed across methods whenever possible. For LoRITa, the factor weight decay is part of the method and is varied as its regularization strength. For Q3R, our AdamQ3R implementation supports the same decoupled weight decay used by the AdamW baselines and SLORR runs. Across methods, ordinary weight decay is applied only to weight matrices; normalization parameters and biases are not decayed.

对于持续的训练实验，我们选择学习率，以便非正则化的基线在很大程度上保留了预训练检查点的准确性。在 ViT-B/16 上，Q3R 在学习率较小的情况下往往表现不佳，因此我们测试了较大的学习率。 LoRITa 在该设置中也略有改进，因此我们将两个学习率都包括在内。我们没有为其他模型或 ResNet-18 预训练探索这种较高学习率设置（对于 ResNet-18，学习率再次根据非正则化性能选择）。For continued training experiments, we choose learning rates so that an unregularized baseline largely preserves the accuracy of the pretrained checkpoint. On ViT-B/16, Q3R tended to perform poorly with the smaller learning rate, so we tested a larger one. LoRITa also improved slightly in that setting, so we include both learning rates. We did not explore this higher-learning-rate setting for other models or for ResNet-18 pretraining (for ResNet-18, the learning rate was again chosen based on unregularized performance).

我们注意到，尽管我们的扫描比之前的工作要广泛得多，但训练配置的差异可能有利于不同的技术。因此，我们的比较应该被解释为在大多数匹配的训练方案下进行的广泛的尽力而为的研究，而不是像中提到的详尽的扫描We remark that even though our sweeps are significantly more extensive than those of prior work, differences in training configurations might benefit different techniques. Accordingly, our comparisons should be interpreted as a broad best-effort study under mostly matched training recipes rather than as an exhaustive sweep, as mentioned inSection˜5.

对于 ViT-B/16，我们使用的学习率为For ViT-B/16, we use learning rates of1×10−51\times 10^{-5}和and5×10−55\times 10^{-5}，批量大小为 1024，权重衰减为 0.1，余弦计划具有 1 轮线性预热, a batch size of 1024, a weight decay of 0.1, and a cosine schedule with 1 epoch of linear warmup[18, 37]初始因子为with an initial factor of10−310^{-3}，然后衰减到原始学习率的 0.1 倍。我们通过以下方式使用标准 ViT-B/16 增强, followed by decay to 0.1 times the original learning rate. 我们使用与 ViT-B/16 相同的设置，但批量大小为 896。批量大小为 1024 时，LoRITa 会产生内存不足错误，即使我们进行了优化。因此，我们在此设置中对所有方法使用 896 的批量大小，以确保可比较的条件。我们只使用了学习率We use the same setup as for ViT-B/16, but with a batch size of 896. With a batch size of 1024, LoRITa produced out-of-memory errors, even with our optimizations. We therefore use a batch size of 896 for all methods in this setting to ensure comparable conditions. We only used a learning rate of1×10−51\times 10^{-5}.

ResNet-50 的超参数。Hyperparameters for ResNet-50.

对于 ResNet-50，我们使用的学习率为For ResNet-50, we use a learning rate of5×10−55\times 10^{-5}。我们使用与 ViT 实验相同的调度程序，批量大小为 1024，权重衰减为 0.01。我们应用标准数据增强，包括随机调整大小和裁剪，然后以 0.5 的概率进行水平翻转，并使用标准 ImageNet-1K 均值和标准差进行归一化。. We use the same scheduler as in the ViT experiments, a batch size of 1024, and a weight decay of 0.01. We apply standard data augmentation, consisting of random resizing and cropping, followed by horizontal flipping with probability 0.5, and normalization using the standard ImageNet-1K mean and standard deviation.

方法超参数选择。Method hyperparameter selection.

通过探索性运行和手动粗调到微调来选择特定于方法的超参数。 SLORR 和 LoRITa 各有一个主正则化系数，而 Q3R 有两个相互作用的超参数（不包括刷新间隔），使得详尽的网格搜索不切实际。对于 Q3R，我们发现值大于作者推荐的范围Method-specific hyperparameters were selected through exploratory runs and manual coarse-to-fine tuning. SLORR and LoRITa each have a single main regularization coefficient, whereas Q3R has two interacting hyperparameters, excluding the refresh interval, making exhaustive grid search impractical. For Q3R, we found that values larger than the authors’ recommended range of[0.001,0.01][0.001,0.01]在我们的环境中工作得更好。worked substantially better in our settings.

对于所有方法，更强的正则化通常会提高可压缩性，但可能会降低未压缩的准确性或导致训练崩溃。相反，正则化太少对可压缩性影响不大。仅当运行崩溃或产生不可用的未压缩精度时才被丢弃，而不是基于压缩后的性能。所有包含的配置都列在For all methods, stronger regularization generally improved compressibility but could reduce uncompressed accuracy or cause training collapse. Conversely, too little regularization had little effect on compressibility. Runs were discarded only when they collapsed or produced unusable uncompressed accuracy, not based on post-compression performance. All included configurations are listed inAppendix˜G.

E.4 分解细节Factorization Details

我们的因式分解实现改编自 BALFOur factorization implementation is adapted from the BALF[17]存储库。对于每个模型，我们都会分解除第一层和最后一层（通常是分类器）之外的所有层。正如正文中提到的，我们进行了均匀截断和能量截断的实验。我们在下面描述两者；我们的实现包含在我们的代码中。repository. For every model, we factorize all layers except the first and last, typically the classifier. As mentioned in the main text, we perform experiments with both uniform truncation and energy truncation. We describe both below; our implementation is included in our code.

统一截断。Uniform truncation.

给定目标保留率Given a target retention ratioc∈(0,1]c\in(0,1], 与, withc=1c=1表示没有压缩，每个符合条件的层都会被截断以大约保留一小部分denoting no compression, each eligible layer is truncated to approximately retain a fractioncc其原始参数。根据我们的矩阵解释，相同的秩选择还为线性层和卷积层提供了大致相同的保留 FLOPs 分数。因此，统一截断在符合条件的层之间应用相同的压缩比，尽管不同的层可能仍然保留不同的参数和 FLOP 的绝对数量。of its original parameters. Under our matrix interpretation, the same rank choice also gives approximately the same retained FLOPs fraction for both linear and convolutional layers. Thus, uniform truncation applies the same compression ratio across eligible layers, although different layers might still retain different absolute numbers of parameters and FLOPs.

在我们的整个实验中，我们遵循 Q3R 的主要实验，使用 5 的刷新周期。除了目标排名和正则化强度之外，扫描周期是不切实际的，因此我们使用他们推荐的配置。Throughout our experiments, we use a refresh period of 5 for Q3R, following their main experiments. Sweeping the period in addition to the target rank and regularization strength would have been impractical, so we use their recommended configuration.

然而，为了完整起见，我们还在少量运行中扫描了刷新间隔，以探讨是否可以使用更大的周期（这样更有效），以及相应的精度权衡是什么。我们将自己限制在 ViT-B/16。However, for completeness, we also swept the refresh interval over a small number of runs to probe whether one could use a larger period, which is more efficient, and what the corresponding accuracy tradeoff would be. We limit ourselves to ViT-B/16.
